text:
maya: quick probe from this morning — after the kernel-selection flip and new continuous batching decay, short prompts (<=32 tokens) in the 'velocity' cohort have a weird p99 spike. anyone else see this? :thinking:

 tj: saw a blip in alerts. p50 stable, p95 fine, p99 up ~40-60ms for that cohort. looks correlated with KV prefetch misses?

 evan: posted raw sample from profiler (10k reqs):
```
cohort: velocity-0.5
p50: 12ms
p95: 28ms
p99: 112ms
kv-prefetch-hit-rate: 73%
avg-decode-steps: 8
avg-batch-size: 3.1
```

 li: that 73% hit-rate stands out. new admission decay reduces prefix reuse window by 30% for short prompts — might be evicting entries before later micro-batches can reuse them.

 maya: hmm. kernel flip also moved some short-seq executions to the 'small-optimized' kernel which favors low per-token latency but is less friendly to KV streaming. could be two interacting changes.

 tj: can we reproduce with a targeted bench? request pattern: 70% short single-turn prompts, 30% mixed long chat. if we replay with and without the decay change, we can isolate.

 benchmark-bot: queued replay job 2118502600 for 10k reqs (70/30 distribution). will attach traces when done.

 evan: quick local replay (2k reqs) shows p99 reduction back to ~30ms when decay window doubled. suggests eviction threshold too aggressive for velocity cohort.

 li: suggestion: per-cohort token-budget target instead of global decay. shorter cohorts get slightly larger live-KV budget to keep reuse for a few extra batches. config prototype: 
```
queue.policies:
  velocity-0.5:
    token_budget_target: 1200
    kv_live_window_ms: 450
  velocity-1.5:
    token_budget_target: 800
    kv_live_window_ms: 250
```

 maya: I like per-cohort budget. also want to test bumping kernel affinity back to previous mapping for velocity-0.5 only. two knobs: kv_live_window & kernel-selection.

 tj: can we add an A/B rollout? canary 5% of traffic with per-cohort tweak + kernel revert, 5% control with current flags. use rollout name "vel-bucket-kv-experiment".

 ops-bot: canary created: vel-bucket-kv-experiment @ 5% on us-west1. monitor: latency_slo, error_rate, cost_delta. I'll auto-rollback if p99 > 2x baseline.

 evan: one more datapoint — decode-rate bucket classifier sometimes mislabels short-but-fast decodes into medium bucket because decode-rate is noisy at low token counts. classifier smoothing would reduce kernel-flips.

 li: propose simple EMA on decode-rate over last 3 requests for a session before reclassifying. that should stabilize kernel selection for small sessions.

 maya: agreed. next steps: (1) bench replay with per-cohort kv budgets, (2) enable EMA smoothing in classifier, (3) start canary rollout. I'll open a tiny PR with the config and experiment harness. @tj can you own SLO dashboards?

 tj: on it. will add cohort breakdowns (p50/p95/p99) and KV hit-rate panel.

 benchmark-bot: replay job 2118502600 finished — attaching summary link: https://bench/redwood/2118502600 (results look promising, full trace uploaded). :thumbsup:

 maya: thanks everyone. if canary stable after 30m we'll promote. ping here with any regressions. :rocket:
